title: Is a Second Marriage Without Divorce Legal?
desc: Marrying again before a divorce is final is void under section 17 of the Hindu Marriage Act and bigamy under section 82 BNS, with up to 10 years in jail.
keywords: is second marriage valid without divorce
why: Over four lakh marriages are now registered under Uttarakhand's Uniform Civil Code, and that record makes it far easier to show in court that a person already had a spouse living when they married again.
keyPoints: A second marriage during the subsistence of the first is void under section 17 of the Hindu Marriage Act, 1955.
It is also bigamy under section 82 of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS), 2023, punishable with up to 7 years in jail.
Hiding the first marriage from the new spouse is a separate, harsher offence under section 82(2) BNS, with up to 10 years in jail.
The law excuses remarriage only if the earlier marriage was legally dissolved or declared void, or the first spouse has not been heard of as alive for 7 years.

sections.h: Is a second marriage valid if the first one is not dissolved?
p: A second marriage is void under section 17 of the Hindu Marriage Act, 1955, if either party already has a living spouse and that first marriage has not ended in a valid divorce or annulment. It also counts as bigamy under section 82 of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS), 2023, punishable with up to 7 years in jail and a fine. Courts in Uttarakhand, including the Family Court at Haldwani, treat such a second marriage as having no legal existence from the start.

This rule applies to Hindus, Buddhists, Sikhs and Jains under section 5(i) read with section 11 of the Hindu Marriage Act, which lists a living spouse at the time of marriage as a ground that makes the marriage void. The second marriage does not need a court order to be treated as void, though parties often still get a formal declaration for clarity on property or inheritance.

sections.h: What if the new spouse did not know about the first marriage?
p: Concealing the earlier marriage from the person being married is a separate, more serious offence under section 82(2) BNS, carrying up to 10 years in jail, compared to 7 years for bigamy alone. This protects a spouse who was deceived into an invalid marriage.

The law makes two exceptions. Remarriage is not an offence if the earlier marriage has been declared void by a court of competent jurisdiction, or if the first spouse has been continuously absent for 7 years and not heard of as alive by people who would naturally have known, provided the facts are disclosed to the person being married.

whatToDo: Get a decree of divorce, annulment or judicial separation finalised before registering or solemnising a second marriage.
Keep the decree, its registration details, and any UCC marriage registration number, since these are the first documents a court will ask for.
If you are the deceived spouse, you can file a criminal complaint for bigamy and separately seek a declaration that the second marriage is void.
Before relying on the 7-year absence exception, get legal advice on your own facts, since the burden of proving genuine belief in the spouse's death falls on the person who remarried.

hi.title: क्या बिना तलाक के दूसरी शादी मान्य है?
keyPoints: पहली शादी के रहते दूसरी शादी हिंदू विवाह अधिनियम, 1955 की धारा 17 के तहत शून्य (void) मानी जाती है।
यह भारतीय न्याय संहिता (बीएनएस), 2023 की धारा 82 के तहत बहुविवाह का अपराध भी है, जिसमें 7 साल तक की सजा हो सकती है।
नए जीवनसाथी से पहली शादी छिपाने पर धारा 82(2) के तहत अलग और सख्त सजा है, जो 10 साल तक हो सकती है।
छूट तभी मिलती है जब पहली शादी कानूनी रूप से समाप्त या शून्य घोषित हो चुकी हो, या जीवनसाथी 7 साल से लापता हो।
